name: cerberus
description: Connect Codex to a scoped Cerberus instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped Cerberus tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to Cerberus through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so Cerberus Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Cerberus only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
